803-4477-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-4477-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-5478-5700-5701-8338.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5478-5700-5701-8338.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1722-2034-3583-7818.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-7818.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

529-955-5641-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

206-529-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4691-4971-6036.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
You control an Angel.
4691-4971-6036.description:
Activate Book of Exalted Deeds by paying {W}{W}{W}, tapping it, and exiling it, giving an Angel you control an ability that prevents you from losing the game this turn.
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until your library is empty.

1981-2292-2415-2999.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2292-2415-2999.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Pirated Copy and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3240-5231-6462-7396.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1988-3490-5315-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1988-3490-5315-7426.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat

1687-3967-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2757-3713-5078-6766.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Steelfin Whale, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

1739-2034-3693-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

6774-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
6774-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Loading Zone.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

198-1978-5793.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {1} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat
198-1978-5793.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.

1836-4316-4423-6618.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
1836-4316-4423-6618.description:
Cast Relm's Sketching from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Mystic Sanctuary.
When the Mystic Sanctuary token enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Relm's Sketching from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate the Mystic Sanctuary token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, causing you to add {U} for each other Mystic Sanctuary you control.
Activate the original Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, causing you to add {U} for each other Mystic Sanctuary you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 4.

215-1753-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-1753-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

969-1305-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

542-3682.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using one mana that can be generated by Mox Amber.
542-3682.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Mox Amber from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1799-2034-5359-5496.description:
Activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and two Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

2558-2829-5346-5433.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Crime Novelist and Krenko trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on the Crime Novelist.
Resolve the Krenko trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
When the Goblin enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Goblin token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2584-4133-5256.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an ability from Altar of Dementia is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1306-1393-2034-4986.manaNeeded: {1} if the permanent requires five or more mana to cast
1306-1393-2034-4986.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic permanent card in hand that can be cast using {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
1306-1393-2034-4986.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the historic permanent from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the historic permanent cast in step 3 from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.
1306-1393-2034-4986.notes: If the historic permanent can be cast for less than {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}, this combo nets infinite mana.

229-656-2232-5705.description:
Cast Endless One by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Endless One spell.
When Endless One enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ugin's Conjurant from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Ugin's Conjurant spell.
When Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Endless One from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

890-2410-4753.notablePrerequisites:
Clever Impersonator  is a copy of Myr Galvanizer.
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
890-2410-4753.description:
Activate either Myr Galvanizer or Clever Impersonator by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

784-3008-3327-3719.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed a number of artifacts and/or creatures this turn equal to the number of times you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game minus four.
You control at least one additional creature.
784-3008-3327-3719.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure artifact tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{R}.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls by paying {2}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} and sacrificing the original Ruthless Technomancer.
Activate the Ruthless Technomancer copy by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning the original Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Repeat from step 7.

86-2792-3489.notablePrerequisites:
Mistblade Shinobi does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
86-2792-3489.description:
Declare Mistblade Shinobi as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Mistblade Shinobi from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Mistblade Shinobi's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mistblade Shinobi onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2645-3436-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Worn Powerstone's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3436-3918.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

1912-1978-3660.notablePrerequisites: Millikin does not have summoning sickness.
1912-1978-3660.description:
Activate Millkin by tapping it and milling a card, adding {C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Millikin.
Repeat.

374-2645-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five mana-producing snow lands.
374-2645-4657.description:
Activate five snow lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Winter's Night triggers five times, adding at least {5}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {5} and tapping it, untapping five snow lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

55-3063-5094.manaNeeded: {12}{G} minus {1} for each unique Gate you control
55-3063-5094.notablePrerequisites: You have at least ten Gates with different names in library or on the battlefield under your control.
55-3063-5094.description:
Cast New Frontiers by paying {9}{G} minus {1} for each unique Gate you control.
Resolve New Frontiers, causing you to search your library for that many Gate cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped, and allowing each opponent to do the same for basic lands.
Activate Maze's End's second ability by paying {3}, tapping it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, searching your library for a Gate, putting it onto the battlefield and causing you to win the game.

1283-3746-4170-4747.notablePrerequisites:
Robaran Mercenaries does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater that entered the battlefield this turn.
1283-3746-4170-4747.description:
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Alena's ability by tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Fain's fourth ability by paying {4}, untapping Robaran Mercenaries.
Repeat.

435-747-1636-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Bloom Tender and Go-Shintai do not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken Shrine.
You control a black and a red permanent.
435-747-1636-5168.description:
Activate Auratog by sacrificing another nontoken Shrine, giving Auratog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Go-Shintai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning any Shrine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The Shrine enters the battlefield, triggering Go-Shintai, creating a 1/1 Shrine enchantment creature token.
The Shrine token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
